core_obligations: Prove Well-Ordering implies comparability (proof lines 721-727): well-order A and B, take order-type isomorphisms from ordinals alpha and beta onto them; since ordinals are comparable by inclusion, the composite of one isomorphism-inverse with the other is an injection between A and B in the direction dictated by the inclusion.

Prove comparability implies Well-Ordering (proof lines 729-735): fix A and take its Hartogs ordinal beta with no injection beta into A; comparability yields an injection f from A into beta; pull back the membership order of beta along f, i.e. order A by requiring f(a) in f(b), to well-order A.
proof_roadmap: Compose order-type isomorphisms to compare A and B (proof lines 721-727).
Apply comparability against the Hartogs ordinal and pull back its order (proof lines 729-735).
difficulty_reason: Two short directions, each a composition of named cited results with one explicit construction (the pulled-back order); 17-line proof, no omissions.
